resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry software supporting B3LYP with 6-31G*, 3-21G*, 6-311G(2d,p), and Huzinaga [8s4p1d] basis sets (e.g., PySCF, ORCA, Psi4, NWChem)

access.notes: Any package that correctly implements B3LYP and the required basis sets is acceptable. The original study used Gaussian98, but an open-source equivalent yields numerically equivalent results within tolerances.
